question: Exploratory only: which retained target byte pieces admit zero, one, or multiple decompositions over nonempty auxiliary byte pieces?
decision_rule: EXPLORATORY_COMPLETE requires pinned prior full classification and record, pinned retained input inventories before/after, sequential full IDs, prior classification counts and unique reconstructions verified, and all empty auxiliary IDs enumerated. Smoke runs the same checks to a separate result. No tokenizer or quality conclusion.
controls: Outer completion checks result/input seals and enumerated auxiliary IDs without job-only environment. Retained inventories and prior full records copied into scratch with fixed pins; smoke has separate exclusive output.
limitations: Original native census remains inconclusive; input inventories are retained bytes, not proven tokenizer behavior.
Ambiguous counts capped at two; empty auxiliary pieces enumerated separately and excluded from decompositions.
